prompts.name: A-teal-workbench
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE beautifully crafted but realistically implementable Linux TERMINAL screenshot design proposal for 拾传 · PickDrop, a LAN group chat and file transfer tool. Wide 16:10 image, straight-on full-bleed interface, high resolution, crisp readable Chinese. THIS IS A CHARACTER-CELL TERMINAL, all letters same font size on an exact monospace grid; Chinese glyphs occupy two cells. Only flat solid colors, Unicode straight box-drawing borders and block progress. No desktop/window chrome, photography, wallpaper, gradients, shadows, rounded cards, graphical icons, avatars, speech bubbles, thumbnails or oversized type. Well-composed readable density, avoid excessive blank space. Show demo data, no passwords.
Exact UI content: brand "拾传 · PickDrop", current group "我的传输群", another group "开发测试群", "2 台在线". Devices: "Linux Server · 本机", "MacBook Air", "Android · 离线". Chronological unified timeline contains: "19:05" "MacBook Air" "协议文档更新了，放在这里"; file "[DOC] 协议内容 v5.docx" with "156 KB · 已存入群主机"; "19:06" "Android" file "[APK] base.apk" with "108 MB · 已存入群主机"; "19:07" "Linux Server · 我" "收到，正在上传构建包。"; "19:08" "MacBook Air" "构建完成后我来下载。". Active task "build.tar.gz" "上传中" "64%" "69 MB / 108 MB" with a terminal block bar filled roughly 64%. Composer prompt "输入消息…" and block cursor. Network "ens42f0 · 192.168.1.30". Bottom footer exact "Ctrl+P 菜单  Ctrl+O 发文件  Ctrl+G 切换群  Esc 返回  Ctrl+C 退出界面". Do not depict search, folder transfer, resume/pause, encrypted/lock symbols, read receipts, cloud sync, speed/ETA, or delivery to every device. This is concept artwork for selection, not functional software.
Direction A: Teal Workbench. Frame a premium three-pane TUI: 20% width left groups navigation, 57% central mixed conversation, 23% right devices and active transfers. Dark graphite-blue background #0B1318, subtly lighter panels #101D23, pale text #DCE8EA, muted text #8CA2AA and reserved mint-teal #3ED6BE accents. Thin square character borders and precisely aligned headings give superb structure. Top brand strip, then full-height three panes, bottom global key hints. Left contains two groups and quiet instructions for Ctrl+G. Selected group dark teal full-row fill. Central timeline has sender headers and readable two-line file records, no card backgrounds. Right shows two online devices, one offline device, then current upload/progress. Do not duplicate upload in the center. Active composer anchored at center bottom with teal border; only focused pane has strong border. Use subtle network at lower right. Header includes small terminal text "A / 青绿工作台". Make excellent balanced use of the full canvas without large empty regions.

Direction C: Paper Console. A highly polished high-contrast LIGHT TERMINAL, entirely solid warm ivory #F3F2ED background, dark graphite #252B31 monospace glyphs, muted #606B73 metadata, forest green #196B59 focus. SINGLE-CANVAS compact composition, NO sidebar, no boxed panels. Top slim horizontal header contains brand, group, online count. Second row is compact plain-text group switcher, active group subtle pale green highlight. Main content is elegant organized timeline table: narrow aligned timestamp column, aligned sender column, wider content column.
